problem.problem:
Bob is blue. Bob is white. Charlie is green. Charlie is quiet. Charlie is round. Charlie is white. Erin is blue. Erin is cold. Erin is green. Gary is big. Gary is blue. Gary is cold. Gary is green. Gary is quiet. Gary is round. Gary is white. White things are cold. If something is blue then it is white. If something is cold then it is round. If something is green then it is quiet. All round, big things are green. If Bob is round then Bob is big. All white, quiet things are big. If something is big then it is cold. If something is blue and quiet then it is cold.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Bob is not green.

Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?

Facts:

White(Bob, True) ::: Bob is white.
Green(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is green.
Quiet(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is quiet.

White(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is white.

Green(Erin, True) ::: Erin is green.

Green(Gary, True) ::: Gary is green.
Quiet(Gary, True) ::: Gary is quiet.
Round(Gary, True) ::: Gary is round.
White(Gary, True) ::: Gary is white.

Rules:
White($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: White things are cold.
Blue($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: If something is blue then it is white.
Cold($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: If something is cold then it is round.
Green($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: If something is green then it is quiet.
Round($x, True) && Big($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: All round, big things are green.
Round(Bob, True) >>> Big(Bob, True) ::: If Bob is round then Bob is big.
White($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: All white, quiet things are big.
Big($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If something is big then it is cold.
Blue($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: If something is blue and quiet then it is cold.

Query:
Green(Bob, False) ::: Bob is not green.
